title: Factorial growth and norm growth
statement: As $d$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, the function $\left(\frac{(3d)!^2}{(d!)^6}\right)^{1/4}$ is of the same asymptotic order as $(3d)^{-1/2}(\sqrt{3})^{3d}$; that is, their ratio is eventually bounded above and below by positive constants.
